2: A song. A Psalm of Asaph. O God, be not silent; be not speechless; be not still, O God.
3: See how Your enemies rage, how Your foes have reared their heads.
4: With cunning they scheme against Your people and conspire against those You cherish,
5: saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”
6: For with one mind they plot together, they form an alliance against You—
7: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,
8: of Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, of Philistia with the people of Tyre.
9: Even Assyria has joined them, lending strength to the sons of Lot. Selah
10: Do to them as You did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the River Kishon,
11: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.
12: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, and all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
13: who said, “Let us possess for ourselves the pastures of God.”
14: Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.
15: As fire consumes a forest, as a flame sets the mountains ablaze,
16: so pursue them with Your tempest, and terrify them with Your storm.
17: Cover their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name, O LORD.
18: May they be ever ashamed and terrified; may they perish in disgrace.
19: May they know that You alone, whose name is the LORD, are Most High over all the earth.
